newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks end ahead a hair in slow session.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks end ahead a hair in slow session.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed largely flat in a slow session that saw little foreign bidding, traders said.
The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index edged ahead 0.29 percent to close at 5,851.54 points as 19 million shares traded worth 2 billion bolivars ($4.3 million).
"We're still not seeing any important foreign capital inflows, although at least the bolsa looks to be recuperating a little," said Investico broker Jose Antonio Oliveros.
Brokers said the market would only begin to accelerate when details of the slated CANTV global offering became known.
Among traded issues, 15 fell, 14 rose while seven ended flat.
